summary: Nabors Industries Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting a waiver to its amended credit agreement allowing its subsidiary Nabors Delaware to optionally redeem up to $100 million of its 9.125% senior priority guaranteed notes due 2030, expected around August 12, 2026. This is a routine debt covenant waiver and partial redemption, not a special-situation event. No change in control, strategic review, or shareholder-related action is involved. The waiver was granted by required lenders, with Citibank as administrative agent. The redemption is a capital management move; watch for any impact on leverage but no risk-arb angle applies.
